messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service=runtime-hotpath severity=page (latency SLO burn). 128 alerts in 5m. p95>600ms, p99>1s. Link: https://telemetry.redwood/runtime-hotpath/alerts/1741223344
alex: acked — taking lead, I'm on it. pinging infra if we need extra capacity.
priya: are there customer-facing errors or just latency? any recent deploys?
sam: no deploys in last 30m. seeing KV cache eviction spike and CPU throttling on sidecars in eu-west.
jordan: tagging infra: @infra-team can we check node autoscaler / GPU queue depth?
alex: quick snapshot:
```
prod.runtime.hotpath.p95 = 620ms
prod.runtime.hotpath.p99 = 1.4s
kvcache.evictions/sec = 432
sidecar.cpu_throttle = 18%
batched_requests_inflight = 240
```
priya: thanks. customer-impact alert threshold: >1% of requests latched => page support. current error rate stable at 0.2%.
alex: trying immediate mitigation: 1) enable fallback route to model-v1-small for non-high-fidelity requests 2) kick a kvcache-prefill for hot keys 3) scale up runtime pool by 3 nodes. Applying now.
alex: runbook commands:
```
kubectl -n runtime scale deployment runtime-pool --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy runtime-pool -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+3))
curl -X POST https://ops-api/kv/prefill -d '{"keys": ["user_history","session_prefix"]}'
# route change
redwoodctl routes set hotpath --fallback model-v1-small
```
sam: k8s nodes are spinning up (eu-west). autoscaler reports 3 pending GPUs.
jordan: I'll watch PD escalation if ack drops, but alex already has it. keep an eye on regional splits.
alex: mitigation started — p95 down from 620ms -> 310ms in 2m. p99 trending down to 750ms.
priya: good. let's mark incident as mitigated but keep monitoring for 30m. if p99 stays >800ms we escalate to infra lead.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation timer cleared (ack present).
alex: leaving a short postmortem note in incidents/ and will follow up with root cause once KV eviction analysis finishes.
jordan: +1. notify CS if any customers reported slow UX.
priya: will draft customer bulletin if impact persists.
alex: resolving page in PD now, will update thread when fully stable. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved for thread 1741223344 (duration 12m).
